function_signature: public static int arrayAndQueries(int[] A, int[][] queries)
prompt_text: Write an optimized Java solution for the HackerRank problem Array and Queries.

bug_analysis.bug_description: The solution recomputes the entire answer by iterating over all possible values for every query, leading to excessive time complexity.
bug_analysis.root_cause: O(Q * maxVal) complexity due to full scan of frequency array on each update.
bug_analysis.bug_location: Loop iterating from 0 to maxVal inside each query
